stories.headline: Hind Rajab's grandmother rejects Israeli army probe into killing, calls for independent international investigation: Report

opening: The grandmother of five-year-old Palestinian girl Hind Rajab has rejected an Israeli military probe into her killing, Anadolu Agency reported. Following an announcement by the military admitting to Rajab's killing, Hind’s grandmother told Anadolu that the family has no confidence in Israeli investigations or the Israeli judiciary.

The grandmother has instead demanded that an independent international investigation be conducted into the killing of Hind, six of her relatives and two Palestine Red Crescent medics who tried to rescue her.

stories.title: Meme magic: how a crude Chinese animation reshapes country’s viewing habits
stories.summary: A crudely made animated film has emerged as an unexpected cultural flashpoint in China, sparking debate over how memes and online virality are reshaping audience perceptions of what is worth watching. Niu Lai, or The Arrival of the Ox, premiered in China on August 5, following a young calf’s dreamlike journey to becoming a warrior. stories.title: Savarkar defamation case: High Court plea accuses court of trying to determine if Savarkar ‘brave or coward’
stories.summary: The petitioner, claiming to possess expert knowledge of Savarkar’s life, contended that the subject before the Special Court is limited. He argues the court should only determine whether Savarkar wrote about beating up a Muslim in his books, and not go beyond this aspect.
